name: Governor's House, and Pedro Fort, Macao
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary:
A view westwards along the Praya Grande; on the left is the pedimented entrance to S. Pedro Fort, with a Portuguese flag aloft; see also E.1748-1928.
On the back are pencil sketches of boatwomen and soldiers.
